version: v0.9.33 at commit 3e48fcb533baaf026cdf8ba371c9f1f0d5f1f03e (built from the repo's deploy/Dockerfile; iii 0.25.1)
notes: Keyless (no provider, EMBEDDING_PROVIDER unset; status: 'Embeddings: bm25-only', 'Provider: noop'). Server daemon required (iii compose with state, http and agentmemory workers); first start fetched the pinned state/http workers from the iii registry, so network was on for startup and import, then the container was disconnected before the queries. 'agentmemory import-jsonl' imported 32 files, 709 observations. Queries: POST /agentmemory/search with only {query} (mem::search, the path behind memory_recall and the one the project's own eval adapter uses); default returns 20 observations. index_bytes is /data/state_store.db only; /data in total was 38 MB including worker binaries and the copied transcripts.
